page.overview:
Who is Brigo?

Despite being used to bad omens, feels as though they have been getting worse. When he notices , does not recognize him and asks if they have met before. However, he says it does not matter who is because he is tired of talking to himself, stating that has come at a good time. He continues by asking if he has seen the that have popped out of the ground all over the place.

Since the long deserted have also started glowing, believes the end is here. Because of these events, he is keeping his eye on "that thing", referring to the nearby , in case it starts moving. describes the broken down as being shaped like an overturned .

Closer to , a had chased down and shot blue beams of light to kill him, but he managed to escape into the nearby woods. asks if he thinks his lightning fast reflexes saved him. However, he laughs off the comment and says he just got lucky. Since are said to still wander around , tells to be careful.

If asks for directions to , points to and says that on the other side there is a where he can ask for further directions. exclaims in surprise if asked for directions to , stating that no matter how many lives has, it is not enough to face the many there. Despite this, he points in the right direction, although he believes it would be better to view the from . is confused when asks for directions to the abandoned , which is surrounded by a high cliff. points in the 's direction and tells to be careful of monsters.
